f.title: Include adverse event reports from the last five years with a summary report
f.statement: The Pharmaceutical Documentation dossier of a new drug submission includes adverse event reports from the last five years, with a summary report.
f.applicability: New drug submissions in Trinidad and Tobago

rows.quote: 4.7 Adverse Event Reports (Within the last five years with summary Report)

f.statement: The Pharmaceutical Documentation dossier of a new drug submission includes a Risk Management Plan.

f.title: Optionally include the latest PSUR/PAR with summary reports
f.statement: The most recent Periodic Safety Update Reports or Public Assessment Reports (PSUR/PAR) with summary reports may optionally be included in the new drug submission.
f.applicability: New drug submissions in Trinidad and Tobago

f.title: Include safety sections in the package insert
f.statement: Where a package insert/patient information leaflet applies, its text should contain at least, among other items, precautions, warnings, adverse reactions, contraindications, interactions, overdose (risk and management) and use during pregnancy and breast-feeding.
f.clause: (5) Manufacturing Documentation - 5.9 Package Insert/Patient Information Leaflet
f.applicability: New drug submissions with a package insert/patient information leaflet

f.title: State in the package insert where to report problems with the medicine
f.statement: The package insert should explain the importance of monitoring patient use and where to report possible problems with the medicine.
f.clause: (5) Manufacturing Documentation - 5.9 Package Insert/Patient Information Leaflet
f.applicability: New drug submissions with a package insert/patient information leaflet
